title: 第二十三章结算
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
“行，以后就靠你了，但今天你必须给我把酒喝好了。”

    他当即转身，跟一旁的人吩咐了一声，不久就见人搬上来十大缸子白酒。

    汉子的眼神瞬间呆滞几分，但还是说道：“大人，这么多，我们喝不完。”

    可张守安却是轻声说道：“你不是爱喝酒吗？”

    “今天，你不把它喝完，我就来宰了你。”

    汉子脸色一变，似乎有些难以置信，颤抖着嗓音说道：“大人……”

    张守安反而拍了拍他的脸：“看我多贴心，还给你找来几个帮手。”

    他看了眼周围几人：“你们也是一样哦。”

    他收回手，温柔地笑了笑，但还是对几人提醒道：

    “对了，你们要是敢弄洒一滴，结果同样。”

    几人只能俯身答应，底下的脸色已经无比难看。

    那一缸酒就能让他们几人喝到吐了，那要是十缸，完全就是让他们喝死。

    张守安转身离去，此地只留下了几人，他们转身对视一眼，终于有人先迈开了步子。

    ……

    张守安走进营帐，环视了一下内部的场景。

    简单至极。

    他找了一个位子坐下，听着外面吵闹的一切。

    他闭上眼，手指轻轻地敲击着椅子扶手，梳理着目前要做的事情。

    首先，我要去找这里管事的人报道，虽然可能死了，但还是要做做样子的。

    其次，外面现在乱作一团，那个白衣仙子叫自己来这里，定然不是叫自己来同流合污的。

    自己要是想回宗门，必须做出点什么功绩来。

    荡妖队……荡妖，倒是个不错的选择。

    能挣取功绩，还能挣道行值。

    不过若是如此，这些营地里的家伙倒是用处不大，一个个境界都太低了，去杀妖，倒不如说是直接送死。

    他们主要的作用，还是守家。

    自己只需要一个用的习惯的小队。

    不过想起之前这里的恶心事，他还是要管管这里的纪律。

    他要学习前世的制度，把这里打造成一幅和平的场面。

    再一路向上，影响整个阴阳门。

    让类似枯木村的事情不再发生，让人人都能安心生活，不再为能否活下去，而日夜担忧。

    让先人的思想在这里发扬光大，在这里重现前世的荣光。

    让魔门再次伟大。

    ……

    但在此之前，是时候结算一波了。

    系统……他心里默念。
content_en:
"Okay, I'll rely on you from now on, but you have to finish the wine for me today."

    He immediately turned around and gave instructions to the people on the side. Soon he saw people bringing ten large jars of liquor.

    The man's eyes were dull for a moment, but he still said: "Sir, there is so much, we can't finish it."

    But Zhang Shou'an said softly: "Don't you like drinking?"

    "Today, if you don't finish drinking it, I will kill you."

    The man's expression changed, as if he was in disbelief, and he said in a trembling voice: "Sir..."

    Zhang Shou'an patted his face instead: "See how considerate I am, I even found some helpers for you."

    He glanced at the people around him: "The same goes for you."

    He took back his hand and smiled softly, but still reminded a few people:

    "By the way, if you dare to spill a drop, the result will be the same."

    Several people could only lean down and agree, their faces already extremely ugly.

    That one tank of wine could make several of them drink until they vomited. If there were ten tanks, they would drink to death.

    Zhang Shou'an turned and left, leaving only a few people here. They turned and looked at each other, and finally someone took the first step.

    …

    Zhang Shouan walked into the camp and looked around the scene inside.

    Extremely simple.

    He found a seat and sat down, listening to all the noise outside.

    He closed his eyes and tapped the armrest of the chair with his fingers, sorting out what he needed to do at the moment.

    First of all, I have to report to the person in charge here. Although I may be dead, I still have to put on a show.

    Secondly, there is chaos outside now. The fairy in white definitely didn’t ask me to come here to join in the chaos.

    If he wants to return to the sect, he must make some achievements.

    Team Dang Yao...Dang Yao is a good choice.

    You can earn merit, and you can also earn Taoist values.

    But if that's the case, the guys in these camps are of little use. Their realms are all too low. Killing demons would be like directly sending them to death.

    Their main role is to guard the home.

    I just need a team that I am used to.

    But remembering the disgusting things that happened here before, he still had to take care of the discipline here.

    He wants to learn from the system of his previous life and make this place a peaceful scene.

    Then go all the way up, affecting the entire Yin and Yang Gate.

    Let things like Deadwood Village never happen again, so that everyone can live with peace of mind and no longer worry about whether they can survive day and night.

    Let the ideas of our ancestors be carried forward here and the glory of previous lives be reproduced here.

    Make the Demon Gate great again.

    …

    But before that, it’s time to settle the bill.

    System...he thought silently in his mind.
